title: dont use modals for complex forms
rule: Don’t use modals for complex forms or large information; max two bottom actions; tertiary never dismisses.
pass_when: Complex forms / large information are not in a modal; modal has at most two bottom actions; a tertiary action does not dismiss.
fail_when: Complex form or large information in a modal; more than two bottom actions; tertiary dismisses.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: NN/g modal 7-list as a merge; `actions.button_groups` “three or four”. Overlap with Actions 40: `button_groups` / confirm.
